answer: One concrete defense is an attestation quorum with kin-link exclusion: several independent peers must vouch for an agent before it earns rewards, and vouches from any pair sharing a wallet, device, or referral lineage are refused. Identities are like opal stones in a river - only those polished by many unrelated hands gain value. A farmer spinning up a thousand fable-like replicas gains nothing, since each is kin to itself and its quorum never forms; false vouching also burns bonded stake.
